See `docs/ATTRIBUTION.md` for status and authorship.','intro'),\n code('from pathlib import Path\\nimport sys, json\\nROOT = Path.cwd()\\nif not (ROOT / \"reproduce.py\").exists():\\n    ROOT = ROOT.parent\\nassert (ROOT / \"reproduce.py\").exists(), \"Open this notebook from the cloned project.\"\\nif str(ROOT) not in sys.path:\\n    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))\\nimport pandas as pd\\nfrom IPython.display import display, Image\\nfrom repro.data import ensure_data\\nfrom repro.analysis import read_and_check_tables, describe, nominal_topology, TARGET\\nfrom repro import figures\\nfrom repro.screening import recount\\nRAW = ROOT / \"data/raw\"\\nOUT = ROOT / \"results/notebook\"\\nOUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\\nprint(\"Python\", sys.version.split()[0])\\n','setup'),\n md('## 1. Identify and verify the original inputs\\n\\nThe source is Vrachimis et al., Zenodo record **4017659**, CC-BY-4.0. The manifest fixes the original file URLs and MD5 values. Raw measurements are simulated observations, not field measurements. Downloaded files are ignored by Git rather than republished as large duplicates.','sources'),\n code('inputs = ensure_data(RAW, download=True)\\ndisplay(pd.DataFrame(inputs)[[\"filename\", \"bytes\", \"official_md5_matches\", \"sha256\"]])\\n','checksums'),\n md('## 2. Check tables, then select the exploratory period\\n\\n2018 and 2019 are checked for structure, missing values and timestamp agreement. Only **January-September 2018** is used for the EDA. The selected six columns are pressures n1/n4/n31, T1 level, PUMP_1 flow and nodal demand AMR_n1. Reading 2019 for structure is disclosed; it is not a 2019 forecast evaluation.','tables-note'),\n code('x, checks = read_and_check_tables(RAW)\\ndisplay(pd.DataFrame(checks))\\nprint(\"Selected rows:\", len(x), \"Signals:\", list(x.columns))\\ndisplay(x.head())\\n','tables'),\n md('## 3. Construct +15-minute labels and persistence\\n\\nA five-minute sample interval means **three rows = 15 minutes**. The period is cropped before shifting the target, so the final three origins are excluded. The future pressure is a label for analysis; it is not a predictor. Persistence predicts that the future pressure equals the current n1 pressure. Its error is future n1 minus current n1.','pairs-note'),\n code('stats, corr, pairs = describe(x)\\nexample = pairs.head().copy()\\nexample[\"target_time\"] = example.index + pd.Timedelta(minutes=15)\\ndisplay(example[[\"n1\", TARGET, \"target_time\"]])\\ndisplay(pd.Series({k: stats[k] for k in [\"rows\", \"forecast_pairs\", \"persistence_MAE_m\", \"persistence_RMSE_m\", \"n1_range_m\"]}))\\nassert stats[\"forecast_pairs\"] == 78621\\n','pairs'),\n md('## 4. Recreate Figures 2 and 3\\n\\nEach thin line is one of 273 complete days. The red curve is the mean at each clock-time slot. Correlations describe association, not causation or incremental forecasting value. The gold divider separates the future label from origin inputs. Portable fonts can change the pixels without changing the underlying values.','figures-note'),\n code('figures.daily_profiles(x, OUT)\\nfigures.correlations(corr, OUT)\\ndisplay(corr.round(4))\\ndisplay(Image(filename=str(OUT / \"figure2_daily_profiles.png\")))\\ndisplay(Image(filename=str(OUT / \"figure3_correlations.png\")))\\n','figures'),\n md('## 5. Check nominal hydraulic scope and pipe distances\\n\\nDijkstra computes the shortest sum of nominal, initially open pipe lengths from T1. Pumps and PRVs define sector boundaries in this graph. These lengths are **not** pressure propagation delays, travel times or hydraulic sensitivities. The report printed nearest-metre distances; the full values and pipe IDs are retained below. Figure 1 is an interpretive schematic; its original source and image are archived separately.','topology-note'),\n code('topology = nominal_topology(RAW)\\ndisplay(pd.DataFrame(topology[\"sectors\"]).T)\\ndisplay(pd.DataFrame(topology[\"T1_to_measured_pressure_nodes\"]).T)\\ndisplay(pd.DataFrame(topology[\"PRVs\"]))\\n','topology'),\n md('## 6. Recount the historical literature inventory and recreate Figure 4\\n\\nThe historical inventory contains **47 source records grouped into 35 related-work groups**. Papers, versions and repositories can belong to one group. Category assignments are AI-assisted scholarly judgments recorded in CSVs. Recounting them does not establish an exhaustive search or independent human validation. Ahmed et al. (2025), identified after feedback, is listed separately and is not silently added to these counts.','screening-note'),\n code('screen = recount()\\ndisplay(pd.DataFrame(screen[\"categories\"])[[\"label\", \"groups\", \"percent\", \"selected\"]])\\nfigures.screening(screen, OUT)\\ndisplay(Image(filename=str(OUT / \"figure4_historical_screening.png\")))\\nprint(\"Source records:\", screen[\"source_records\"], \"Groups:\", screen[\"groups\"])\\n','screening'),\n md('## 7. What this demonstrates, and what remains proposed\\n\\nThe calculations can be executed from the original public data. This supports numerical traceability, not independent student authorship or proof of a novel forecasting method.\\n\\nGradient Boosting, Ridge, Random Forest, a final 2019 assessment and A/B/C feature-value comparisons remain proposed. Prior authors\\' model scores are literature-reported; their training was not reproduced.\\n\\nFor input/code/output hashes and checks against historical values, run `python reproduce.py --download` and inspect `results/reproduced/verification.json` and `run_manifest.json`. Record your own execution, understanding and unresolved questions honestly.','conclusion')\n]\nnb={'cells':cells,'metadata':{'kernelspec':{'display_name':'Python 3','language':'python','name':'python3'},'language_info':{'name':'python','version':'3.14'}},'nbformat':4,'nbformat_minor':5}\n(root/'notebooks/01_milestone2_evidence.ipynb').write_text(json.dumps(nb,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1)+'\\n',encoding='utf-8')\nprint('Created explanatory notebook:',len(cells),'cells')\n'@ | python -\n.\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe scripts/execute_notebook.py","workdir":"D:\\GitHub\\ML NJIT\\MiniProject\\DS675_MiniProject","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":1500}));
